item.spiderman.web_shooter.tip.shoot: Right-click: shoot a web line / let go
item.spiderman.web_shooter.tip.zip: Sneak + right-click: web-zip straight to the spot
item.spiderman.web_shooter.tip.swing: While swinging: W pumps your swing, A/D steer
item.spiderman.web_shooter.tip.release: Jump mid-air: let go with a boost
item.spiderman.web_shooter.tip.yank: Hit a mob to yank it to you
